findings.title: RUSTSEC-2023-0071: rsa crate timing side-channel, pulled in via sqlx's optional mysql feature
npm audit (fornax-docs): 24 findings (18 rated high by npm), transitive through Docusaurus 3.10.2's dev-server dependency chain
findings.evidence: npm audit fornax-docs: 24 findings, 18 rated high by npm's own advisory severity; every one of the 18 is reachable only through the local Docusaurus dev server, never through the published static site fornax-docs actually ships (static HTML/JS with no dev-server process running in production); no clean fix without a Docusaurus major bump. Severity here is rated at its effective severity to this candidate (unreachable in the shipped artifact), not npm's upstream advisory rating; the reachability argument that justifies the downgrade is stated here rather than left implicit.

findings.title: FORNX-280: tool_input and Claim.text reached daemon log, SQLite store, and export-spool output unredacted
findings.evidence: Full-stack secret-egress canary (random-hex marker) found raw marker in daemon log, SQLite store, and fornax export-spool output via AgentEvent.tool_input and Claim.text; tool_response/raw.* redaction confirmed still working in the same repro. Fixed in crates/fornax-daemon/src/main.rs's handle_message (fornax-core#29, merge commit f309bc21caad2bf8b994b7f366ba2a42eea27c63). Regression test tool_input_and_claim_text_are_redacted_before_storage added. Re-verified with a fresh canary marker: zero raw hits post-fix.

findings.title: FORNX-281: event/claim ordering race intermittently computed Unverified instead of CONTRADICTED on real CI
findings.evidence: Not reproducible on demand locally (15/15 local runs passed both before and after the fix); real GitHub Actions run intermittently hit the race. Fixed by serializing message processing behind a single AppState.processing lock (fornax-core#32). Re-verified: cargo test --workspace clean, adversarial corpus run 15x locally post-fix (15/15), next real CI run on this PR passed.

findings.title: fornax-adapter-claude's last_assistant_text reads a Stop hook's transcript_path with no confinement to $FORNAX_HOME
findings.evidence: Static review during FORNX-238's adversarial pass: content from an arbitrary local path (even via ../../ traversal) can reach the claims table if it parses as expected transcript JSONL. No privilege boundary is crossed (hook runs as the invoking user).

findings.title: Dashboard html_escape helper does not escape quotes
findings.evidence: Static review of frontend/src during FORNX-238's XSS campaign: safe today only because no rendered field is placed inside an HTML attribute.
